mathematical_review.objective: The code forms rhs=A^T rhs_a and solves (A^T A)x=rhs with the pinned matrix-free A normal action and exact diag_a Jacobi preconditioner. A's .25 identity rows make the normal positive definite; its diagonal has a minimum contribution of .0625 per variable.
mathematical_review.scope: The solve is unconstrained. It does not replace ADMM or authorize a terrain; it reports box, D8, and native face-radius violations for both x64 and direct float32 conversion.

native_constraint_oracles.box: Compares x values against the prepared inward float32 bounds.
native_constraint_oracles.D8: Uses the pinned structured operator's center/witness flat indices and reports witness-minus-center violations.
native_constraint_oracles.faces: Checks every one of 8,380,418 native triangular faces using the two direct raw-height gradient components and its prepared radius; it does not infer water from P/F or emit a candidate.

findings: The run timer now starts at function entry and is passed into the watchdog, so input pinning, module loading, PCG, direct postchecks, and final readset hashing share the 300-second deadline.

The watchdog samples every 0.25 seconds, latches time/memory/free-RAM failures, and the code checks it at solver callbacks, stage boundaries, after output serialization, and around final source rehashing.
A final guard failure produces a terminal failure status and the CLI returns nonzero; only COMPLETE_OBJECTIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_UNACCEPTED returns zero.
The actual 2,712,136-variable screen has not been run, so the 3-GiB peak and 6-GiB reserve are enforced caps, not a prediction that the run will fit or converge within 300 seconds.

execution.acceptance_claim: None; output is explicitly unaccepted continuous-vector diagnostic only.
